intro.title: Create an API key
intro.step1: Sign in at platform.stroohm.com with your usual STROOHM account.
intro.step2: At the bottom left, click your name, then "Profile". At the top right, open "Personal API keys", click "+ New" and create an application, for example named "Homey".
intro.step3: Copy the Client ID and the Client secret. The secret is shown only once.
intro.note: The key stays on your Homey and is only sent to STROOHM/Monta.

credentials.title: Your API key
credentials.missing: Enter both the Client ID and the Client secret.

setup.title: What have you already received?
setup.olderHint: Optional: what you received before Monta (previous platform), the kWh charged at home, and your public/office charging (kWh and cost) — per month, or per year if you only know the totals. Home kWh are costed with the average of your tariff (device settings); entering public kWh keeps the home share accurate. Editable later in the app settings.
setup.intro: Monta pays the refund of each month on the 1st of the next month: the app assumes every closed month is refunded and shows the current month as pending. Nothing to confirm.

settings.title: Stroohm
settings.none: Add a Stroohm device first, then come back here.
settings.monthsHint: "Before Monta": amount received, home kWh, public kWh and public cost before Monta for that month or year (all optional). Home kWh are costed with the average of your tariff; the home share only includes periods where public kWh are entered. Empty or 0 removes it.
settings.copied: CSV copied. Paste it into Excel or Google Sheets.
settings.ignored: Ignored: Monta already has data for
settings.tariffHint: How the cost of home charging is calculated (also editable in the device settings). Gain/loss = refund − this cost.
settings.modeMonta: Tariff set in the STROOHM app
settings.profileHint: Measured: the real hour of each kWh (Monta data), priced on your off-peak hours. The other choices apply a fixed average. kWh entered by hand (before Monta) always use the average: the custom share when "Measured" is chosen.
